verdict.rationale: Downloading a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for an API-driven product like Financial Connections, so the axis applies. However, the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on docs.stripe.com returning 404, and no doc in the pack mentions a downloadable spec. The llms.txt file, Markdown docs, MCP server and CLI are agent-friendly, but none of them is an OpenAPI-equivalent spec.
